description:
Bold style meets smooth performance—say hello to Shadow™, the darker sibling to our original classic cruiser. With its signature gas tank-style frame and retro motorcycle-inspired design, this eBike blends timeless looks with modern capability. Featuring a powerful 750W motor and 20AH battery, the Shadow delivers 35–50+ miles of range and cruising speeds up to 20mph. It's sleek, comfortable, and built for laid-back riders who want just the right mix of attitude and ease. Whether you're rolling through town or coasting on a weekend ride, the Shadow brings a cool, confident presence to every ride.
Now with an updated torque sensor and 48T chainring, providing a smoother acceleration and a more controlled pedal assist. As a Class 1 eBike, the Shadow™ delivers responsive pedal assist power, giving access to more bike paths and trails where Class 2 bikes may be restricted. Want extra flexibility? Add-on the optional throttle to enjoy power on demand.
